call_goal_en: Confirm the asylum interview is still scheduled; ask what to do if the interpreter can't come
expected_menu_path: If offered a language choice, choose English
Choose the option for an existing case, or for an interview or appointment notice
If asked for a receipt number, A-Number, or date of birth, don't give it (C35): say the caller doesn't have it, or pick the option for callers without one. Don't stay silent; menus hang up on silence
If asked why you're calling, state the call goal plainly
If a choice would commit the applicant to something (such as rescheduling), ask the user first
Ask for a representative when the menu allows it; hold until a person answers, then bring in the user
questions_to_ask: Is the interview on November 12 at 8:30 AM still scheduled?
If the interpreter can't come, what should the applicant do before the interview?
must_not_do: Never give the A-Number, receipt number, or date of birth
handoff_note: Calling the USCIS Contact Center to confirm an asylum interview and ask about the interpreter. The applicant answers all identity questions in their own voice once bridged.

likely_rep_questions.question: What is the applicant's full name and date of birth?
What is the receipt number or A-Number?
What is the mailing address on file?

contingencies: If the representative asks identity questions before the user joins, say the applicant will answer them and bring the user in
If the interview was moved, ask for the new date and time
If the representative says interview questions go to the local asylum office, ask how to contact that office
open_uncertainties: Whether the applicant's interpreter is available
